Black bean and plantain salad ingredients =  1/2 pound (1 cup) dried black beans [180g] 1 fresh jalapeño pepper, seeded and minced 1 cup long-grain white rice [200g] 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper 2 tablespoons unrefined sugar cane 6 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 to 3 tablespoons extra virgin oil 2 plantains, peeled and cut diagonally into 1/4-inch [.5-cm] slices 6 tablespoons lime juice 1/4 cup coarsely chopped cilantro [60ml] 1 large red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch [1-cm] dice Hot sauce directions =  Place the beans in a large saucepan and add enough cold water to cover by 2 inches [5cm]. Let stand 6 to 8 hours or overnight. Drain, return the beans to the pan, and cover them with fresh water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook until the beans are tender but not falling apart, 45 to 60 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold running water until cool. Drain well. In a medium saucepan, cook the rice in 2 cups [500ml] lightly salted water, covered, until the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Transfer the cooked rice to a large bowl and fluff with a fork. Season with 1/2 teaspoon of the salt and 1/8 teaspoon of the pepper. Heat the vegetable oil in a large heavy skillet, preferably cast-iron, over medium-high heat. Add the plantain slices, in batches if necessary, and fry, pressing down gently with a spatula from time to time, until golden brown on both sides, about 2 to 3 minutes. Reduce the heat slightly if the plantains brown too quickly. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt. Pour all but 2 tablespoons oil from the pan. Add the bell pepper to the skillet and sauté over medium-high heat until softened and slightly browned around the edges, 3 to 4 minutes. Add the jalapeño pepper, garlic, cumin seeds, and sugar and sauté 1 minute longer, stirring constantly. Add the cooked beans, fried plantains, and sautéed pepper mixture to the rice. Add the olive oil, lime juice, and cilantro. Mix well. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Serve at room temperature. Pass a bottle of hot sauce on the side. tags =  salad vegetarian Latin American healthy side dish plantains beans gluten-free prep time =  6 to 8 hours (soaking) plus 15 minutes cook time =  1 hour 15 minutes yield =  Serves 6

White Bean Soup ingredients =  350 g/12 oz/1 1/2 cups dried cannellini or other white beans 1 bay leaf 75 ml/5 tbsp olive oil 1 medium onion, finely chopped 1 carrot, finely chopped 1 stick celery, finely chopped 3 medium tomatoes, peeled and finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped 5 ml/1 tsp fresh thyme leaves or 2.5 ml/1/2 tsp dried thyme 750 ml/1 1/4 pints/3 cups boiling water Salt and freshly ground black pepper Olive oil, to serve directions =  Pick over the beans carefully, discarding any stones or other particles. Rinse thoroughly in cold water to ensure that they are clean. Soak in a large bowl of cold water overnight. Drain the beans and place them in a large saucepan of water, bring to the boil and cook for 20 minutes. Drain the beans. Return the beans to the pan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil again. Add the bay leaf and cook until the beans are tender for approximately 1-2 hours. Drain again and remove the bay leaf. Puree about three-quarters of the beans in a food processor or pass through a food mill, adding a little water if necessary, to create a smooth paste. Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Stir in the onion and cook until it softens. Add the carrot and celery, and cook for 5 minutes more. Stir in the tomatoes, garlic and thyme. Cook for 6-8 minutes more, stirring often. Pour in the boiling water. Stir in the beans and the bean puree. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 10-15 minutes. Serve in individual soup bowls, sprinkled with a little olive oil. tags =  soup vegetarian healthy comfort food Italian dinner gluten-free bean prep time =  Overnight soaking plus about 20 minutes active prep cook time =  Approximately 1 hour 40 minutes yield =  Serves 6 per serving =  Not specified tip =  Other types of canned cooked beans, such as cannellini or borlotti, may be substituted in this recipe. Simply drain the beans and omit Step 1.

Haricot Bean Salad ingredients =  1 cup/175g/6oz dried haricot beans, soaked overnight 2 cloves garlic, crushed 2 tbsp/30ml wine vinegar 2 tbsp/30ml olive oil 1 tsp/5ml French mustard salt and freshly ground black pepper 1 red pepper, seeded and thinly sliced 1 leek, thinly sliced 2 spring onions, green and white parts chopped separately directions =  Place the beans in a large saucepan and cook with fresh water. Bring to the boil and boil fast for 10 minutes, then cover and simmer for 40-50 minutes or until tender. Drain the beans. Combine the garlic, vinegar, olive oil, mustard and seasoning in a screw top jar, seal and shake well. Pour over the hot beans and leave to cool. Stir in the pepper, leek and white parts of the spring onions and place in a serving dish. Sprinkle with green chopped onions and serve. tags =  salad vegetarian healthy side dish gluten-free low fat easy lunch prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  50 minutes yield =  Serves 4

Roasted garlic-lemon tofu and broccoli ingredients =  2 heads of garlic 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons olive oil Freshly ground pepper 2 to 3 tablespoons lemon juice 1/4 cup vegetable oil, for frying (60ml) 1 tablespoon brown rice vinegar 1 pound extra-firm tofu, preferably thawed frozen, pressed to remove excess water and sliced lengthwise in half (500g) Several dashes of Tabasco sauce 1/4 cup vegetable stock (60ml) 1/2 pound broccoli florets (250g) directions =  Preheat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Separate the heads of garlic into individual cloves. Skin them and cut off the hard bits on the ends. It’s okay if the cloves are slightly crushed as you get the skin off them. Toss the garlic cloves with the olive oil to coat lightly and cook them in a covered baking dish for 30 to 40 minutes, or until lightly browned and very soft. You may toss them once or so while they are cooking. In a medium bowl, mash the roasted garlic to a paste with a fork. Add 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice, the vinegar, Tabasco, vegetable stock, salt, and a generous grinding of pepper. Mix well. In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat until very hot. Fry the tofu, turning once, until lightly browned and crisp on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain the tofu on paper towels and lightly salt it. Pour out all but 1 to 2 tablespoons oil from the pan. While the tofu is still warm, cut it into cubes and stir into the marinade. Toss until very well coated. Let marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes. Heat the cast-iron skillet over high heat. Pour the tofu with all its marinade into the skillet. Use a rubber spatula to scrape all the marinade out of bowl. Cook, stirring constantly, until the marinade is completely absorbed and the tofu is well coated. Steam or blanch the broccoli until just tender, 3 to 5 minutes; drain. Reheat the tofu and marinade, if necessary. Add the broccoli and toss gently to mix. For best results, finish with a splash of lemon juice and a dash of Tabasco sauce. tags =  vegetarian tofu broccoli dinner healthy savory easy gluten-free prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  40 minutes yield =  Serves 2

White bean and roasted garlic spread ingredients =  1 head of garlic 3 or 4 dashes of Tabasco sauce 2 tablespoons plus 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil 1 tablespoon plus 1⁄2 teaspoon minced fresh herbs, such as oregano, thyme, and mint 2 cups cooked white beans [330g] Vegetable stock or soy milk (optional) 2 teaspoons ground cumin Salt and freshly ground pepper 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice directions =  Preheat the oven to 325°F [160°C]. Separate the head of garlic into individual cloves. Skin them and cut off the hard bits on the ends. Toss the cloves with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil to coat lightly and cook in a covered baking dish for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden and soft. You may toss them once or twice while they are cooking. In a food processor, combine the roasted garlic with the beans, cumin, lemon juice, Tabasco, 1 tablespoon minced herbs, and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil. Puree until smooth. If the spread is too thick, thin with vegetable stock or soy milk, adding 1 tablespoon at a time. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Scrape the spread into a serving bowl (a dark-colored bowl will create the most dramatic presentation) and let stand for 1 hour, if you have time. Just before serving, drizzle with the remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil and garnish with the remaining herbs. tags =  appetizer snack vegetarian healthy Mediterranean easy spread gluten-free prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  40 minutes yield =  Serves 6 to 8 per serving =  Not specified

Rosemary olive oil ingredients =  1 cup extra virgin olive oil [250 ml] 4 to 6 sprigs fresh rosemary directions =  Place the olive oil in a small glass or ceramic bowl. Creamy toasted garlic dressing ingredients =  6 garlic cloves, skins on 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 teaspoon mellow white miso 1 1/2 teaspoons honey 2 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar directions =  Heat a dry cast-iron skillet or heavy frying pan over medium heat. Toast the unpeeled garlic, turning over with tongs occasionally. Allow the garlic to brown in spots, about 15 minutes. Let cool, then peel and coarsely chop. Puree the garlic along with the rest of the ingredients in a blender or mini food processor until smooth. Let the dressing stand for 1 hour before serving. tags =  dressing savory vegetarian condiment garlic easy healthy salad prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  About 1/3 cup (75 ml) note =  This savory, slightly tangy dressing is creamy, with a beautiful pale yellow color.

Marinated Vegetable Antipasto ingredients =  3 red peppers 3 yellow peppers 4 garlic cloves, sliced handful of fresh basil 120 ml/4 fl oz/1/2 cup olive oil salt and freshly ground black pepper 450 g/1 lb open cap mushrooms, thickly sliced 60 ml/4 tbsp olive oil 1 large garlic clove, crushed 15 ml/1 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary 250 ml/8 fl oz/1 cup dry white wine fresh rosemary sprigs, to garnish 1 dried red chilli, crushed grated rind of 1 lemon 120 ml/4 fl oz/1/2 cup olive oil 225 g/8 oz/1 1/3 cups Italian black olives 30 ml/2 tbsp chopped fresh flat leaf parsley basil leaves, to garnish 1 lemon wedge, to serve directions =  Place the peppers under a hot grill and cook until they are black and blistered all over. Remove from the heat and place in a large plastic bag to cool. When the peppers are cool, remove their skins, halve the flesh and remove the seeds. Cut into strips lengthways and place them in a bowl with the sliced garlic and basil leaves. Season and then cover with oil and marinate for 3-4 hours, tossing occasionally. Garnish with basil leaves. Place the mushrooms in a large bowl. Heat the oil in a pan and add the garlic, rosemary and wine. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 3 minutes. Season and pour over the mushrooms. Mix well and leave to cool, stirring occasionally. Cover and marinate overnight. Serve at room temperature, garnished with rosemary sprigs. Place the chilli and lemon rind in a small pan with the oil. Heat gently for about 3 minutes. Add the olives and heat for 1 minute more. Tip the olive mixture into a bowl and leave to cool. Marinate overnight. Before serving, sprinkle with parsley and garnish with basil leaves. Serve with the lemon wedge. tags =  starter vegetarian Italian antipasto marinated healthy appetizer herbs prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  10 minutes yield =  Serves 4 note =  This colourful selection of fresh vegetables and herbs makes a great starter when served with fresh crusty bread.

Tantalizing Taco ingredients =  1⁄3 cup canned pinto beans, rinsed and drained 1⁄8 teaspoon chili powder dash salt dash black pepper 1 hard corn taco shell 1⁄2 roasted red pepper, sliced lengthwise 2 thin slices onion 1⁄4 avocado, peeled, pitted, and sliced 1 tablespoon low-fat shredded sharp cheddar cheese or nondairy cheese 3 tablespoons taco sauce directions =  In a small bowl, stir together the beans, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Heat bean mixture in the microwave for 25 seconds. Spoon this mixture into the taco shell. Layer the red pepper, onion, avocado, and cheese on top of the beans. Drizzle the taco sauce on top. tags =  vegetarian lunch Mexican quick easy snack healthy low cholesterol prep time =  4 min cook time =  25 sec yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 258 (from fat 89); fat 10g (saturated 2g); cholesterol 2mg; sodium 588mg; carbohydrate 31g (dietary fiber 9g); protein 8g. variation =  This is one of those lunches where it’s super easy to improvise. If you have black beans or kidney beans or most any other kind of beans left over in the refrigerator, use them up in place of the pinto beans. No corn taco shell? Use provolone or mozzarella or most any cheese you have in the fridge.

Roasted Yellow Pepper Sauce ingredients =  2 yellow bell peppers 1 medium onion, coarsely chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 1/2 to 1 fresh hot pepper (jalapeño, Serrano, or habañero), minced 1/2 banana 1/4 to 1/2 cup dry white wine or vegetable broth [60 to 125 ml] 1 or 2 splashes of peach, mango, white wine, or cider vinegar Salt and freshly ground pepper directions =  Preheat the broiler. Cut the bell peppers lengthwise in half; remove the stems, seeds, and excess ribs. Slit the ends slightly so you can flatten them out. Place the peppers stem side up under the broiler with the rack set about 4 inches [8 to 10 cm] from the heat and broil until they are blackened, about 10 minutes. Let cool, then scrape off the blackened skin and cut the peppers into strips. In a small skillet or saucepan, cook the onion in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil over medium heat until soft and lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. In a food processor, combine the roasted bell peppers, cooked onion, hot pepper, banana, and remaining oil. Blend briefly. With the machine on, gradually add the wine, mixing until smooth and creamy. Strain the sauce through a food mill or fine mesh strainer and scrape into a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer and cook until reduced slightly. The sauce should be a bit thick, but not heavy. Season with salt, pepper, and vinegar to taste. tags =  sauce vegetarian spicy side dish gluten-free broiler peppers easy prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  Makes about 1 cup [250 ml] note =  While this recipe calls for a fairly hot pepper, you can step it up even higher by using a fresh habañero pepper—the boldest of the bold. The combined sweetness of the bell pepper, banana, and caramelized onion will tone down the heat and bring out the citrus overtones of the habañero. Use just a small piece of the habañero to start with; add more only after you have tasted the sauce. The habañero generally has thin skin, which is why only the bell peppers are roasted.

Penne with roasted eggplant, peppers, and feta cheese ingredients =  1 pound eggplant [500g] 1/2 pound penne [250g] 1/4 cup pine nuts [30g] 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese [30g] 1 medium onion, chopped 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh oregano 3 tablespoons olive oil Salt and freshly ground pepper 2 garlic cloves, minced Splash of fresh lemon juice 2 roasted red peppers, homemade or jarred directions =  Preheat the oven to 400°F [200°C]. Pierce the eggplant several times with the tip of a sharp knife. Place the eggplant in an uncovered baking dish and roast for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the eggplant is very fragrant and collapses on its own or easily with a squeeze. Slice the eggplant in half and let cool, then scoop out the meat and coarsely chop it. While the eggplant is cooking, in a large dry skillet, toast the pine nuts over medium heat, tossing constantly, until they are lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Remove the pine nuts and set aside. In the same pan, cook the onion in 1 1/2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium-high heat until lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Put the onion, garlic, roasted peppers, cooked eggplant, and remaining oil in a food processor. Pulse several times until you achieve a nice chunky consistency. Return the sauce to the pan. Bring at least 4 quarts [4L] salted water to a vigorous boil. Add the pasta and stir immediately and often until the water returns to a boil. Cook until the pasta is al dente (slightly resistant to the bite), then drain quickly into a colander. Shake out the water completely. When the pasta is nearly done, reheat the sauce over very low heat. Stir in the feta cheese and oregano. Season generously with salt and pepper. Add a splash of lemon juice and toss with the warm pasta. tags =  pasta vegetarian dinner Italian main course roasted vegetables cheese easy prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  60 minutes yield =  Serves 2 per serving =  Not specified

Pan-Fried Eggplant Sandwich ingredients =  Nonstick cooking spray 1/4 teaspoon olive oil 2 slices frozen breaded eggplant 1 teaspoon mayonnaise 1 kaiser roll, split in half horizontally 1 slice tomato Dash Italian seasoning 1 1/2 tablespoons feta cheese crumbles directions =  Spray a medium skillet with nonstick spray. Add the oil and warm the pan for 20 seconds. Add the eggplant slices and cook over medium heat, turning once, about 3 minutes, or until they’re browned on both sides and hot in the center. Spread the mayonnaise on the bottom half of the roll. Lay the tomato on top and sprinkle the tomato with Italian seasoning. Sprinkle the feta cheese on top. Lay the eggplant on top of the feta cheese and cover with the roll lid. tags =  vegetarian sandwich quick snack easy American breaded eggplant pan-fried prep time =  2 min cook time =  4 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  Calories 311 (from fat 125); fat 14g (saturated 4g); cholesterol 15mg; sodium 529mg; carbohydrate 37g (dietary fiber 2g); protein 9g. tip =  You can get a box of breaded eggplant slices in the freezer section of the grocery store. They’re really convenient because you don’t have to make a breading mix, add the seasonings, or dip the eggplant in oil or egg and then into the crumb mix. And you don’t have to think about what you’re going to do with all the leftover fresh eggplant. variation =  If you’re out of feta cheese, goat cheese or even swiss or pepper cheese will work. No kaiser roll? Use any roll you have on hand, or even two slices of toasted Italian bread.

Stuffed Japanese eggplant ingredients =  1 medium red potato, scrubbed and cut into small dice 2 Japanese eggplants 1/2 pound tomatoes [250g] 2 tablespoons pine nuts 1 small red onion, finely chopped 3 garlic cloves, minced 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 teaspoon dried basil 1 1/2 teaspoons red miso 1 to 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice Salt and freshly ground pepper 4 ounces Monterey Jack cheese, shredded [125g] Shredded fresh basil, for garnish directions =  Steam or boil the diced potatoes until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold running water; drain well. Put the potatoes in a medium bowl. Preheat the broiler with the rack set 5 to 6 inches [13 to 15cm] from the heat. Place the tomatoes on a baking sheet and broil, turning with tongs, until the skin is blistered and slightly charred all over, 3 to 5 minutes. Peel off the skins and coarsely chop the tomatoes. Add the tomatoes to the potatoes. Preheat the oven temperature to 350°F [175°C]. Slice the eggplants in half lengthwise; brush lightly with oil and place cut side down on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, or until just tender. Remove from the baking sheet and let cool. Slice each piece lengthwise in half again so you have 8 long wedges. With a spoon, gently scoop out the cooked eggplant, being careful not to tear the skin. Coarsely chop the eggplant and add to the potatoes and tomatoes. Set the skins aside separately. Toast the pine nuts in a large dry skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Set aside the pine nuts in a small dish. In the same pan, cook the red onion in the olive oil over medium heat until very soft and lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Add the garlic, oregano, and basil and stir for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high. Add the potatoes, tomatoes, chopped eggplant, miso, and 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice. Cook, stirring often, until the excess liquid evaporates and the mixture begins to thicken, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the pine nuts. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add more lemon juice, if desired. Let the vegetable mixture cool a bit, then spoon into the eggplant skins. Top with shredded cheese and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Ideally, cover and refrigerate the dish at this point, giving everything a chance to set nicely. When ready to eat, place the eggplant boats under a preheated broiler until the stuffing is reheated and the cheese melts, about 2 minutes. Garnish with basil before serving. tags =  vegetarian vegetables baked gluten-free healthy dinner side dish Mediterranean prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  40 minutes yield =  Serves 2 to 4

Deviled Egg Delight ingredients =  1 hard-boiled egg, diced 3⁄4 teaspoon low-fat mayonnaise 2 drops mustard dash salt dash black pepper 1 whole-grain bagel, cut in half horizontally 1 large tomato slice 1⁄4 cup baby spinach leaves directions =  In a small bowl, use the back of a fork to mix together the egg, mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper. Spread this mixture on one half of the bagel. Lay the tomato slice and spinach on top of the egg mixture and cover with the other half of the bagel. tags =  vegetarian snack quick healthy low-fat bagel egg American prep time =  5 min cook time =  0 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 383 (from fat 66); fat 7g (saturated 2g); cholesterol 212mg; sodium 856mg; carbohydrate 65g (dietary fiber 11g); protein 19g. variation =  If you want to make this a bit more fancy, add some chopped green pepper or thin slices of avocado.

Eggs a la King ingredients =  1 tablespoon butter 2 tablespoons chopped green pepper 2 tablespoons chopped onion 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms 2 slices whole-grain bread 3/4 cup low-fat cream of celery or cream of mushroom soup 1/2 cup shredded low-fat American or cheddar cheese 1/4 cup milk 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced directions =  Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Sauté the green pepper, onion, and mushrooms in melted butter until the vegetables are soft, about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. While the vegetables cook, toast the bread slices in a toaster. Stir in the soup, cheese, and milk. Lower heat to medium and cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese has melted, about 1 minute. Fold in the eggs. Spoon the mixture over the toast, dividing evenly. tags =  breakfast quick easy low-fat American vegetables eggs toast prep time =  6 min cook time =  4 min yield =  2 servings per serving =  calories 323 (from fat 147); fat 16g (saturated 8g); cholesterol 246mg; sodium 970mg; carbohydrate 26g (dietary fiber 3g); protein 19g. tip =  See chapter 7 for tips on making a perfectly cooked batch of hard-boiled eggs to have on hand all week. If you’re cooking for one, you can either make half the recipe or cover and refrigerate the leftover egg mixture and reheat it tomorrow; that’ll be one morning you don’t have to worry about what’s for breakfast.

Scrambled Tofu ingredients =  2 teaspoons olive oil 2 slices onion, chopped 3 button mushrooms, sliced dash salt dash pepper 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon low-sodium soy sauce 1/3 cup firm tofu 1 slice tomato, diced 1/2 avocado, peeled, pitted, and chopped directions =  In a small skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Stir in the onion and mushrooms and sauté, stirring often, for 3 minutes, until the vegetables are soft and begin to brown. Add the salt, pepper, garlic powder, soy sauce, and tofu. Stir-fry the mixture, stirring occasionally, until the tofu begins to brown, about 3 minutes. Stir in the tomato and cook just until the tomato is heated through, about 30 seconds. Spoon the scrambled tofu onto a serving dish and top with the avocado. tags =  vegetarian breakfast healthy low cholesterol high protein quick easy plant-based prep time =  6 min cook time =  6½ min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 353 (from fat 255); fat 28g (saturated 5g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 256mg; carbohydrate 16g (dietary fiber 10g); protein 17g. tip =  This is another one of those breakfasts that you can convert to a carry-it-as-you-walk-to-class meal. Just pile the scramble into a pita pocket or tortilla wrap.

The ultimate tofu scramble ingredients =  2 tablespoons yellow miso or chickpea miso 1 pound firm or soft (not silken) tofu, drained and pressed of water [500g] 1/2 teaspoon turmeric 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 teaspoons yellow powdered mustard 3 medium shallots or 1/2 onion, finely chopped Dash of wasabi powder (optional) 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast 2 tablespoons chopped chives or scallions 1 teaspoon salt Salsa or vegetarian Worcestershire sauce 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper 1/3 cup vegetable stock or water [75ml] directions =  In a medium bowl, combine the miso, turmeric, powdered mustard, wasabi, yeast, salt, pepper, and stock. Mix to a smooth paste. Crumble the tofu into the miso mixture and blend well. Add 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and mix again until very well incorporated. Set aside. In a medium skillet, preferably nonstick, cook the shallots in the remaining oil over medium heat until softened, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the red pepper and sauté an additional 1 to 2 minutes. Add the tofu mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until the tofu is just heated through and the shallots and bell pepper are mixed in. Remove from the heat. Garnish with chives and top with salsa or Worcestershire sauce. tags =  vegan breakfast lunch brunch tofu healthy plant-based gluten-free prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  7 minutes yield =  Makes 2 large or 3 medium-size portions per serving =  Not specified note =  This vegan delight is the real deal when it comes to tofu scrambles—don’t accept substitutes. tip =  It is excellent topped with fresh salsa or Worcestershire sauce. variation =  Add dried or fresh herbs, or substitute chipotle or regular chile powder for the mustard to spice up the scramble.

Eggless Tofu Salad ingredients =  2⁄3 cup firm tofu 1⁄2 rib celery, diced 2 tablespoons minced green pepper 2 tablespoons minced green onion 1 tablespoon vegan mayonnaise 1⁄4 teaspoon spicy brown mustard dash cayenne pepper 1 teaspoon minced fresh parsley (optional) 1⁄8 teaspoon dried dill 1⁄8 teaspoon salt 1⁄4 teaspoon black pepper 2 slices whole-grain bread 6 spinach leaves directions =  Drain the tofu well between paper towels. Press on the towels to get out as much moisture as possible from the tofu. Crumble the tofu into a bowl, and then mash it with the back of a fork. Add the celery, green pepper, green onion, mayonnaise, mustard, cayenne, parsley (if using), dill, salt, and pepper. Stir until everything is well mixed. Spoon the salad onto a piece of bread, and top with spinach leaves and another piece of bread. tags =  vegetarian salad snack healthy vegan low cholesterol quick plant-based prep time =  10 min cook time =  0 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 414 (from fat 204); fat 23g (saturated 3g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 744mg; carbohydrate 35g (dietary fiber 9g); protein 25g. tip =  If you have time to make this ahead so it can chill in the refrigerator for a half hour, the taste is even better. Make a larger batch of this salad if you like to snack in the evenings. Put a dollop of the salad on top of crackers, and if you still have some left over the next day, make a lettuce wrap.

Tofu with shredded tempeh ingredients =  2 to 3 tablespoons Sweet and Hot Garlic Chili Paste (recipe follows) or jarred garlic chili paste 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon vegetable oil 1 package (8 ounces) tempeh, shredded [250g] 1 teaspoon salt About 6 tablespoons vegetable stock 1 large carrot, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced 2 celery ribs, thinly sliced on the diagonal 1 pound firm or extra-firm tofu, pressed of excess water, cut into 1-inch [2.5-cm] cubes [500g] 1 medium leek (tender white part), thinly sliced and well rinsed Soy sauce (optional) directions =  If making Sweet and Hot Garlic Chili Paste, do this first. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is very hot and almost shimmering, add the tempeh and sauté until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir several times, but allow the tempeh to brown for several seconds on all sides before turning, much like making hash browns. Season with the salt. Add 1 tablespoon of the chili paste and 3 tablespoons of the vegetable stock. Continue to stir until they are completely absorbed into the tempeh. Transfer the tempeh to a plate and set aside. Heat the remaining oil in the pan. Add the carrot and celery and cook over medium-high heat, stirring often, until the vegetables are slightly softened but still crunchy, about 2 to 3 minutes. Add the tofu and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes, until the tofu is lightly browned. Add the leek and continue to cook for another 30 seconds or so, just until the leek begins to soften. Return the tempeh to the pan and mix well. Add another tablespoon of chili paste and the remaining stock. Increase the heat to high and stir constantly until the paste and stock are completely absorbed into the stir-fry. Splash with soy sauce, if desired. Serve at once. tags =  vegetarian Chinese stir-fry spicy dinner healthy tofu tempeh prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  Serves 4 to 6 per serving =  Not specified

Amazing tofu teriyaki ingredients =  3 tablespoons sherry vinegar 4 to 5 dashes of Tabasco sauce 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger 2 tablespoons mirin Freshly ground pepper 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1/4 cup vegetable oil [60ml] 2 tablespoons unrefined cane sugar 1 pound extra-firm tofu, sliced in half or thirds lengthwise [500g] directions =  In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, sesame oil, mirin, soy sauce, sugar, Tabasco, ginger, and a light grinding of pepper. Stir to mix well. In a large cast-iron skillet or heavy-duty frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. When the oil is very hot and almost shimmering, fry the tofu, turning once, until lightly browned and crisp on both sides, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Pour out excess oil from the pan and set aside. While the tofu is still warm, cut it into cubes. Add the marinade and mix until very well coated. Set aside until ready to finish them off in the skillet. If you have the time, let the tofu marinate for 30 to 60 minutes. Increase the heat to high. When the skillet is very hot, pour the marinated tofu and all the marinade back into the pan. Use a rubber spatula to scrape all the marinade out of the bowl. Fry, stirring constantly, until the marinade is completely absorbed and the tofu is well coated. tags =  vegetarian vegan Asian tofu dinner easy quick teriyaki prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  10 minutes yield =  Serves 2

Cream of Corn Soup ingredients =  1 can cream style corn 1 tbsp butter 1 tsp flour 1/2 cup milk 1 cup water 1/4 cup fresh cream salt and pepper to taste directions =  Melt butter in a large pan. Add flour, milk, and water. Keep stirring for 2 minutes until mixture is thick, avoiding lumps. Add corn and cook for 5 minutes on low flame. Add cream and bring mixture to boil, stirring constantly. Serve hot. tags =  soup vegetarian starter comfort food quick easy dinner prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  7 minutes yield =  Serves 4

Corn on the Cob with Garlic Butter ingredients =  Corn on the cob Butter Garlic paste Salted water Olive oil directions =  Remove the outer green leaves from the fresh corn. Place in boiling salted water with a drop of olive oil. Simmer for 20 minutes, or until the corn is cooked and tender. Remove from the heat and drain. Smother liberally with butter and garlic paste. tags =  vegetarian side dish snack quick easy summer American gluten-free prep time =  5 minutes cook time =  20 minutes yield =  Serves 4-6

Roasted corn and mushroom salad ingredients =  4 ears of corn Salt and freshly ground pepper 1/2 onion, chopped Juice of 1 lime 2 tablespoons plus 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil 1/2 red bell pepper, finely diced 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 cucumber, peeled, seeded, and finely diced 10 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, caps sliced 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar 1 avocado, sliced 2 teaspoons ground cumin Chopped watercress or other greens, for serving 1 teaspoon chickpea miso or white miso directions =  Shuck the corn and set the kernels aside. Scrape any excess milk from the cobs with the back of a knife and set it aside in a large bowl. In a very hot cast-iron skillet, roast the corn kernels until lightly browned, stirring often with a wooden spoon. If the corn sticks excessively, add a few drops of oil. Add the roasted corn to the bowl with the corn milk. Cook the onion in the same skillet in 2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium-high heat, until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms. Cook until the mushrooms are soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cumin and miso. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add the contents of the pan to the corn and mix well. Let cool slightly. Add the lime juice, bell pepper, and cucumber. Toss with the vinegar and remaining oil and season again with salt and pepper. Top with the avocado slices. Serve on a bed of chopped watercress or other greens. tags =  salad vegetarian gluten-free healthy side dish summer fresh mushroom prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  Serves 4 to 6

Corn Cheese Canapés ingredients =  1 can (8 oz) corn kernels 1/4 cup grated cheddar cheese 1/4 cup home-made cottage cheese 1 onion, finely chopped 1 green chilli, finely chopped 2 tbsps coriander, chopped 2 tbsps cornflour 2 tbsps butter 1 cup milk 1 cup yogurt salt to taste 1 pack canapés directions =  Heat butter in a saucepan and sauté onions, chillies, cornflour, milk, yogurt, grated cheese and salt. Remove from heat and add crumbled cottage cheese and corn. Stuff mixture in canapés and bake in moderate oven until top layer is golden brown. To serve, arrange canapés on a large serving platter. Decorate with tomato slices and pineapple bits. tags =  snacks vegetarian cheese baked appetizer Indian easy quick prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  20 minutes yield =  1 pack canapés per serving =  Nutritional information not provided

Corn tempeh chowder ingredients =  1⁄2 ounce dried mushrooms (chanterelle, shiitake, or mixed) [15g] 3 tablespoons arame sea vegetable 3 cups fresh or frozen corn kernels [375g] 1 medium onion, chopped 2 celery ribs, finely chopped, leaves reserved for garnish 1⁄2 cup rolled oats [50g] 2 cups vegetable stock or water [.5L] 1 package (8 ounces) tempeh, grated [250g] Salt and freshly ground pepper 4 cups plain soy milk [1L] 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon chickpea miso or white miso directions =  In a small bowl, soak the dried mushrooms and arame in enough hot water to cover. Cover the bowl and set it aside until the vegetables are softened, about 30 minutes. Drain, reserving the soaking water. Coarsely chop both the mushrooms and the arame. Strain the soaking water through a paper coffee filter and set it aside. In a heavy-bottomed soup pot, cook the onion and celery in the olive oil over medium heat until the onion is soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the grated tempeh and cook for 2 minutes longer, stirring frequently. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Stir in the corn and chopped mushrooms and arame. Add the soy milk and reserved soaking water and bring to a simmer. In the meantime, puree the oats with the vegetable stock in a blender or food processor. Stir into the soup and simmer, partially covered, for 30 minutes. Stir often, as oats tend to stick. In a small bowl, blend the miso with a small amount of the soup until well mixed. Stir into the rest of the soup in the pot. Season generously with salt and pepper. Garnish with celery leaves when serving. tags =  soup vegetarian dairy-free comfort food healthy gluten-free vegan main course prep time =  35 minutes cook time =  37 minutes yield =  Serves 8 to 10

Quick, no-cook, stir in Sauce for Pasta ingredients =  6 fresh tomatoes and half a cup of water OR 1 tin of tomatoes A good handful of basil (both stalks and leaves) A handful of parsley 2 sticks of celery, cut into chunks Half a teaspoon of sea salt Dash of soy sauce (optional) 2 teaspoons cold pressed olive oil (leave this out if you want a fat free sauce) directions =  Whizz all the ingredients up in a liquidiser or blender until fairly smooth. Stir the sauce into your favourite pasta. Vegetarian Spaghetti Putanesca ingredients =  1 onion, peeled and diced 2 tbsp/30ml oil 2 cloves garlic, crushed 1 carrot, scraped and chopped 1 1/2 cups/425g/15oz canned tomatoes 2 tomatoes, skinned and chopped 4 tbsp/60ml white wine 1 bay leaf 3-4 basil leaves or 1 tsp/15ml dried basil salt and freshly ground pepper 1 tbsp/15ml capers, chopped ½ cup/50g/2oz stoned black olives 3 drops Tabasco sauce 1 tbsp/15ml freshly chopped parsley 450g/l lb cooked spaghetti grated Parmesan cheese to serve directions =  Put the onion into the oil in a frying saucepan over a low heat. Allow to cook gently for 4 minutes, add the crushed garlic and carrots. Turn in the oil twice more. Add the tomatoes, the white wine, bay leaf, basil and some seasoning. Bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Sieve or liquidize and return the sauce to the saucepan. Add the chopped capers, chopped olives and the spicy Tabasco sauce. Re-heat and serve over the pasta, with Parmesan cheese. tags =  vegetarian pasta Italian dinner main course spicy easy comfort food prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  34 minutes yield =  Serves 4-6

Basic Tomato Sauce for pasta ingredients =  A little olive oil 1 onion, finely chopped 2 - 3 cloves of garlic, crushed 1 can (approx. 400g) tomatoes, chopped 2 Tablespoons of tomato puree 1 or 2 Tablespoons of oregano or mixed herbs 1 cup of veg. stock or water (or even wine, if you like, for a richer sauce) directions =  Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for a few minutes until softened. Add the tomatoes, puree, stock or water and herbs and simmer gently for about 15 minutes. That is the basic sauce - you can add anything you like to it. Any vegetables chopped and added with the tomatoes etc. Soya mince for a more traditional bolognese type sauce. Beans, sweetcorn, peas can also be added. A sweet and sour sauce is easy to make also - add a can of pineapple pieces in pineapple juice and leave out the herbs. A little vinegar is added too. This is great with beans and vegan sausages chopped up. tags =  sauce pasta vegetarian vegan easy Italian gluten-free dinner prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  4 servings per serving =  Approximately 150 calories variation =  Add any vegetables, soya mince, beans, sweetcorn, peas, or make a sweet and sour version with pineapple and vinegar.

Garlic Pasta with Peas ingredients =  4 cups water 2 ounces angel hair pasta 2 small garlic cloves, crushed 2 tablespoons olive oil dash salt dash black pepper 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese directions =  Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Add the pasta to the water and cook over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. While the pasta cooks, sauté the garlic in the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently, for about 40 seconds, or until the garlic starts to turn golden. Remove from heat and stir in the salt and pepper. Stir the peas and the oil-garlic mixture into the pasta and toss well to coat evenly. Just before serving, sprinkle the cheese on top. tags =  vegetarian pasta quick easy Italian dinner main course healthy prep time =  3 min cook time =  6 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 562 (from fat 279); fat 31g (saturated 6g); cholesterol 8mg; sodium 399mg; carbohydrate 56g (dietary fiber 6g); protein 16g. tip =  To convert this recipe to vegan, use nondairy grated cheese in place of the parmesan cheese.

Summer Tomato Pasta ingredients =  275 g/10 oz/2 1/4 cups dried penne 450 g/1 lb plum tomatoes 275 g/10 oz mozzarella, drained 60 ml/4 tbsp olive oil 15 ml/1 tbsp balsamic vinegar Grated rind and juice of 1 lemon 15 fresh basil leaves, shredded Salt and freshly ground black pepper Fresh basil leaves, to garnish directions =  Cook the pasta in boiling salted water, according to the package instructions, until just tender. Quarter the tomatoes and remove the seeds, then chop the flesh into small cubes. Slice up the mozzarella into similarly sized pieces. Mix together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, grated lemon rind, 15 ml/1 tbsp of the lemon juice and the basil. Season with salt and pepper. Add the tomatoes and mozzarella and leave to stand until the pasta is cooked. Drain the pasta and toss with the tomato mixture. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh basil leaves. tags =  pasta vegetarian summer light Italian main course fresh quick prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  10 minutes yield =  Serves 4 per serving =  Light and fresh pasta dish with mozzarella and tomatoes

thai coconut curry ingredients =  150 gms long beans, cut in short strips 1/2 can straw mushrooms, drained 2 carrots, cut in short strips 1/4 head cabbage, shredded 1 cup grated coconut 1 onion, finely chopped 6 cups water 7 dry red chillies, slitted and boiled 6 thai lemon leaves 4 cloves garlic, crushed 1 tsp coriander seeds 1 tsp cumin seeds 2 tsps sugar directions =  Grind onion, garlic, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, lemon leaves and chillies to a paste. Spicy, Fruity Pasty ingredients =  Approx 400g/15oz of frozen vegan puff pastry, defrosted (ready rolled is extra easy!!) Curried chickpeas ingredients =  1 onion, chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 4 cups cooked chickpeas 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder 2/3 cup vegetable stock or dry white wine 1 tablespoon tomato paste 2 teaspoons chickpea miso or white miso Salt and freshly ground pepper Fresh lemon juice directions =  In a large skillet, cook the onion in the olive oil over medium heat until very soft and lightly browned, 7 to 9 minutes. Spoon the rice onto a dish and top with the vegetables. tags =  vegetarian quick healthy dinner stir-fry low cholesterol low sodium brown rice prep time =  2 min cook time =  3 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 387 (from fat 111); fat 12g (saturated 2g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 492mg; carbohydrate 59g (dietary fiber 9g); protein 10g. tip =  If you have more than a few minutes to prepare dinner, forget the frozen veggies and replace them with cut-up fresh vegetables that you have in your refrigerator (such as carrots, onions, green pepper, and broccoli).

Cabbage Stir-Fried ingredients =  4 cups cabbage, shredded 1/4 cup ghee or clarified butter salt to taste cumin seeds mint leaves pinch of turmeric powder 1/2 tsp of red chilli powder directions =  Lunge shredded cabbage in salted boiling water and drain. Heat ghee in a heavy pan and add cumin seeds and mint leaves. Add cabbage and gently stir-fry. Add salt, turmeric powder and chilli powder. Stir to blend. Serve hot with rice or roti. Decorate with chillies, tomatoes and sliced lemon. tags =  vegetarian side dish Indian cuisine spicy healthy quick stir-fry prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  Serves 4-6

Mexican Rice ingredients =  2 cups rice 3 cups water 4 green chillies, chopped 1 clove garlic, crushed 1/4 cup fresh coriander 1/2 onion, chopped 1 cup grated cheddar cheese 1 cup cream 500 gms baby carrots butter directions =  Blend onion, garlic, chillies and coriander in a blender. Mix with cheese and cream and set aside. Cook rice until almost all water is absorbed but not completely cooked. Stir in cheese-chilli-cream mixture. Add a drop of green food colouring, if required. Continue cooking on low heat until done. Serve with parboiled carrots which have been tossed with butter in a sauce pan on low heat. To serve, place carrots in centre of individual plates and surround with rice. tags =  food lunch dinner spicy rice mexican cuisine savory vegetarian prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  30 minutes yield =  4 servings per serving =  Approximately 1 cup of rice with carrots

Brazilian Rice ingredients =  500 g long grain rice, soaked in water 120 ml vegetable oil 1 small onion, chopped 1 clove garlic, crushed 500 ml boiling water salt to taste directions =  Heat oil in a large pan and stir-fry onion and garlic until tender. Drain rice and add to pan, let cook until transparent, stirring constantly. Pour water and cook for 15 minutes. When the rice is partially cooked, lower heat. Cook uncovered until all water is absorbed. Cover and remove from heat. Fluff the rice with a fork before serving. tags =  rice Brazilian main course vegetarian onion garlic gluten-free prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  25 minutes yield =  4 servings per serving =  Calories and nutrition not specified

Indian Rice ingredients =  3 cups basmati, Indian long grain rice, washed and soaked for half an hour. 1 cup peas 1 onion finely chopped 1 tsp garlic-ginger paste 1 big carrot, grated 1 tsp salt 1 bay leaf 2 cardamoms, crushed 4 cloves 1 thumb-sized cinnamon stick 1 tsp lemon juice 4 tbsps oil 3 tbsps clarified butter or ghee 100 gms chopped nuts, cherries, raisins and pineapple bits for garnishing directions =  Heat oil and plunge all spices. When brown, add chopped onions and fry until soft and transparent. Add grated carrot, peas, ginger-garlic paste and fry for a minute, stirring constantly. Stir in rice, then add water and lemon juice. Bring to boil, then simmer for 20 minutes, covered loosely over tiny flame. Turn cooked Indian rice or biryani onto serving plate. Remove bay leaf, cloves and cinnamon stick. Melt butter in a saucepan and pour hot melted butter over the rice dish. Sprinkle nuts, raisins and pineapple bits on top. tags =  Indian Rice Main course Vegetarian Spicy Dinner Traditional prep time =  30 minutes (including soaking) cook time =  20 minutes yield =  Not specified per serving =  Not specified

Japanese Rice Cakes ingredients =  6 cups cooked rice (Japanese variety, slightly glutinous) 1/2 cup vinegar 75 gms sugar 20 gms salt Horseradish, grated Soya sauce Cooked dried gourd (kampyo) for topping Cooked dried mushrooms (shiitake) for topping directions =  Mix vinegar, salt and sugar and pour evenly over cooked rice in a bowl. Cut vinegar mixture into rice with a wooden spoon. This is sushi or Japanese rice. Until the time it is served, keep sushi rice in a wooden tub covered with damp cloth. To serve, mould 1 tablespoon of rice at a time on the palm of your hand. Arrange moulded rice in a serving platter. Top with mushrooms, gourd or your choice of vegetables. Serve with soya sauce mixed with little horseradish as a dip. tags =  Japanese Rice Snack Vegetarian Glutinous Appetizer Traditional prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  0 minutes yield =  Serves 4 per serving =  Calories and nutritional info not provided

Singapore Vegan Noodles ingredients =  Dried rice noodles (200g pack for a family of 4) 2 tablespoons of sunflower oil 3 cloves of garlic, crushed 1 onion cut into inch/2cm long thin strips 1 teaspoon of chilli powder 1 red pepper cut into same strips 1 yellow pepper cut in the same way 1 courgette/zucchini cut into strips Smoked tofu, cut into similar sized pieces 2 tablespoons of soy sauce 2 tablespoons of sesame oil directions =  Cook the rice noodles according to the instructions on the packet - often this is just pouring boiling water over them and leaving them for a while. Cook the onions and garlic in the sunflower oil for a few minutes and then add the chilli and stir in well. Add your vegetables and soy sauce and cook for a few moments until slightly softened. Add the tofu and stir fry for another 10 minutes or so before adding the rice noodles and combining well (you may want to cut them up if they are very long). At the last minute sprinkle the sesame oil over the dish and serve at once. This goes very well with a fresh salad of Chinese cabbage and herbs. tags =  vegan noodles Asian stir-fry dinner healthy quick vegetarian prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  4 servings per serving =  Approximately 1 serving

Vegetarian Hot Dogs and Beans ingredients =  Nonstick cooking spray 1 meatless hot dog, sliced into thin circles 1/3 cup canned vegetarian baked beans, partially drained 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard 1 whole-wheat hot dog bun 2 thin slices onion 3 tablespoons crushed tortilla chips directions =  Spray a small saucepan with nonstick spray. Add the hot dog slices and cook for about 1 minute over medium-high heat, stirring frequently. Add the beans to the pan and continue to cook about 1 minute, or until heated through. Spread mustard inside both halves of the bun and lay the onion slices on one half. Spoon in the hot dogs and beans and top with tortilla chips. tags =  vegetarian sandwich quick snack healthy low cholesterol high protein American prep time =  3 min cook time =  2 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 314 (from fat 43); fat 5g (saturated 0g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 654mg; carbohydrate 46g (dietary fiber 5g); protein 21g. variation =  You can add lots of toppings to this sandwich, including coleslaw, sauerkraut, dill pickle relish, and/or shredded cheddar cheese. You can also toast the hot dog bun if you like.

Open-Faced Pseudo Turkey Sandwich ingredients =  1/3 cup vegetarian gravy 3 slices vegetarian turkey lunchmeat 1 slice whole-wheat bread directions =  Pour the gravy into a small saucepan. Add the lunchmeat and warm over medium-high heat about 2 minutes, or until heated through. While the gravy mixture is heating, toast the bread. Place the toast on a dinner plate and top with the lunchmeat and gravy. tags =  vegetarian sandwich quick lunch healthy low cholesterol vegan option snack prep time =  2 min cook time =  2 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 365 (from fat 77); fat 9g (saturated 0g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 1,774mg; carbohydrate 29g (dietary fiber 8g); protein 49g. tip =  If you’re looking for a can of vegetarian gravy, Imagine Foods has canned, organic wild mushroom gravy, and it’s available in many grocery stores. Franco-American’s canned mushroom gravy is vegan.

Roasted pear sandwich with walnut pesto ingredients =  1 firm ripe pear, halved lengthwise, cored and cut lengthwise into slices about 1⁄4 inch (0.5cm) thick 6 slices of smoked or regular mozzarella cheese 4 leaves of crisp lettuce 1 teaspoon olive oil 3 tablespoons Walnut Pesto (recipe follows) 4 slices of whole-grain bread, toasted Roasted red bell peppers, cut into strips (optional) Salt and freshly ground pepper directions =  Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly coat the pear slices with the olive oil. Spread out in a single layer in a small baking dish and roast for 20 minutes, or until softened and lightly browned. Spread the pesto on one side of each slice of toast. Layer the remaining ingredients on half the slices and season with salt and pepper to taste. Sandwich with the second slice of bread, pesto side down, and press down firmly. Serve at once or wrap tightly in plastic and refrigerate for up to 3 hours. tags =  sandwich lunch brunch vegetarian easy savory fruit nuts prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  20 minutes yield =  Makes 2 sandwiches note =  Pears and walnuts are a classic duo, more familiar in salads than between two slices of bread. This gourmet sandwich offers a variety of contrasting tastes and textures: sweet and savory, soft and crunchy. variation =  There’s plenty of room to improvise with your own additions, if you like. I add roasted red bell peppers to mine. You could use a different-flavored pesto or spread or substitute an apple for the pear.

Hummus or Houmous ingredients =  1 can (approx. 400g) of cooked chick peas (or you can soak overnight and cook 1 cup of dried chick peas) 2 Tablespoons of olive oil 1 - 2 cloves of fresh garlic 2 Tablespoons of tahini (sesame paste) The juice of 1 lemon A little water to blend Salt and pepper (optional) directions =  Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until fairly smooth. You may need to keep adding water bit by bit until you get the consistency you want. tags =  dip spread vegetarian vegan Mediterranean healthy snack gluten-free prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  0 minutes yield =  About 1 cup per serving =  Approximately 100 calories per 2 tablespoon serving note =  This is a traditional Greek dish - can be used as a dip or a spread for sandwiches (fantastic combined with avocado and the naise below, in a sandwich). For a raw dish you can use sprouted chick peas in place of cooked ones.

Ribbon Sandwiches ingredients =  18 slices of no lard crustless bread tomato ketchup mint chutney butter directions =  Apply ketchup to 6 slices of bread and chutney to another 6 slices of bread. Butter the remaining slices on both sides. Take a ketchup slice, top with a buttered bread slice, finally top the two slices with chutney smeared bread slice. Repeat process till all slices of bread are used. This makes 6 sandwiches. Finally cut each sandwich vertically into 4 strips. Arrange ribbon sandwiches horizontally on a serving platter exhibiting the tricolour. tags =  snacks vegetarian sandwich no-cook party food easy quick fusion prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  0 minutes yield =  6 sandwiches

Salad Surprise ingredients =  1 cup canned kidney beans, drained 1 cup cooked macaroni 1 cup pineapple titbits 1 cup canned corn kernels 1 cup raisins 4 carrots, grated 4 tomatoes, chopped 4 small cucumbers, peeled and julienned eggless mayonnaise lettuce leaves chopped nuts for garnishing directions =  On a bed of lettuce leaves, in a shallow salad dish, arrange the first eight ingredients in alternating colours. Refrigerate until served. To serve, drizzle enough mayonnaise over the dish and garnish with chopped nuts. tags =  salad vegetarian cold dish healthy snack lunch easy no cook yield =  serves 6-8

vegetarian omelette ingredients =  1/4 cup chick pea flour (besan) 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 tomato, blanched, peeled and chopped 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese pinch of soda bicarbonate 1/2 cup water 1/8 cup fresh coriander leaves 1/8 cup finely chopped onion 1/4 tsp red chilli powder 1 green chilli, finely chopped directions =  Beat all the ingredients to a smooth batter. Adjust salt. Heat the griddle or non-stick pan and pour 3-4 tablespoons of oil. Ladle 3-4 tablespoons of mixture on pan and spread with the back of spoon. Let it rise. Reduce heat and cook on both sides until golden brown. Serve hot. tags =  vegetarian breakfast snacks cheese spicy Indian quick

Vegetarian Spaghetti Putanesca ingredients =  1 onion, peeled and diced 2 tbsp/30ml oil 2 cloves garlic, crushed 1 carrot, scraped and chopped 1 1/2 cups/425g/15oz canned tomatoes 2 tomatoes, skinned and chopped 4 tbsp/60ml white wine 1 bay leaf 3-4 basil leaves or 1 tsp/15ml dried basil salt and freshly ground pepper 1 tbsp/15ml capers, chopped ½ cup/50g/2oz stoned black olives 3 drops Tabasco sauce 1 tbsp/15ml freshly chopped parsley 450g/l lb cooked spaghetti grated Parmesan cheese to serve directions =  Put the onion into the oil in a frying saucepan over a low heat. Allow to cook gently for 4 minutes, add the crushed garlic and carrots. Turn in the oil twice more. Add the tomatoes, the white wine, bay leaf, basil and some seasoning. Bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Sieve or liquidize and return the sauce to the saucepan. Add the chopped capers, chopped olives and the spicy Tabasco sauce. Re-heat and serve over the pasta, with Parmesan cheese. tags =  vegetarian pasta Italian dinner main course spicy easy comfort food prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  34 minutes yield =  Serves 4-6

Spaghetti Vegetable Salad ingredients =  3 cups spaghetti 1 cup cucumber, diced 1 cup tomato, seeded and diced 1 cup onion, finely chopped 1 cup chopped celery 1/2 cup green pepper, pitted and chopped 1 cup grated cheddar cheese Italian dressing (eggless) directions =  Break spaghetti into pieces. Boil salted water and cook spaghetti in it. Drain spaghetti. Mix together vegetables and cooked spaghetti. Sprinkle grated cheese. Pour some Italian dressing. Toss lightly. Refrigerate until served. tags =  salad vegetarian pasta cold dish healthy lunch quick prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  10 minutes yield =  Serves 6-8

Stewed Vegetable Dinner ingredients =  Nonstick cooking spray 3 medium, unpeeled red potatoes, cut into wedges 1 small onion, diced 6 baby carrots, sliced thin 1 stalk celery, sliced thin 1 box (10 ounces) frozen chopped spinach, thawed 1 can (8 ounces) french cut green beans plus liquid 1 can (8 ounces) garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 can (8 ounces) tomato sauce 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic (fresh or from a jar) 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1 cup frozen peas directions =  Spray the inside of a 2-quart slow cooker with nonstick spray. Stir all the ingredients except the peas into the slow cooker, making sure the potato wedges are at the bottom because they take a little longer to cook than the other vegetables. Cover the pot and cook for 8 hours on low. Fifteen minutes before serving, stir in the peas. tags =  vegetarian dinner slow cooker healthy low cholesterol high fiber gluten free comfort food prep time =  8 min cook time =  8 hr yield =  2 servings per serving =  calories 516 (from fat 84); fat 9g (saturated 1g); cholesterol 0mg; sodium 1,553mg; carbohydrate 93g (dietary fiber 20g); protein 20g. note =  Eight hours of cooking time definitely exceeds the 30-minute limit of this chapter, but follow the reasoning here. This dinner takes only about 8 minutes to assemble, and the slow cooker does the rest, so technically, it’s not your time that’s being monopolized. Right?

Curried potato, chickpea, and corn burgers ingredients =  2 cups cooked chickpeas [320g] 2 tablespoons curry powder 1 pound red potatoes, scrubbed, cut into quarters [500g] 1 teaspoon salt Freshly ground pepper 1 medium onion, finely chopped 2 tablespoons dry white wine or vegetable stock 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 large tomato, coarsely chopped 1 small hot chile pepper, minced 1 cup fresh or frozen corn kernels [120g] 1 1/2 to 2 cups dried bread crumbs [100 to 140g] 1 1/2 teaspoons rice vinegar 1/2 cup canola or safflower oil, for frying [125ml] directions =  Mash the chickpeas in a large bowl or pulse in a food processor until a chunky paste is formed. Set aside. Steam the potatoes for about 10 minutes, or until soft. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the onion in the vegetable oil over medium heat until golden, 5 to 7 minutes. Add the garlic, tomato, chile, and corn. Raise the heat to medium-high and cook, stirring frequently, until the tomato is soft, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the curry powder, salt, and a generous grinding of pepper. Stir and cook for an additional minute or so. When the mixture begins to stick slightly, add the wine. Cook until the mixture has reduced slightly to a thick sauce. Remove from the heat. Add the curry mixture and steamed potatoes to the chickpeas. Mash the potatoes while mixing them in well. Mix in 1/2 cup [35g] bread crumbs. Add the vinegar and additional salt and pepper to taste. If you feel the mixture is too wet, add more bread crumbs. Let cool completely, then form into 8 patties about 3 inches [8cm] in diameter. Spread out the remaining bread crumbs on a clean plate. One at a time, place the burgers on the bread crumbs. Use your hands to carefully coat both sides. Set aside on another plate or clean surface. In a large skillet, heat 1/4 cup [60ml] of the canola oil over medium-high heat. When the oil begins to shimmer, fry 3 or 4 burgers until crispy, 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Look for burgers to be crispy brown on the outside and heated through. Add the remaining oil and, when it returns to temperature, cook the remaining burgers. Drain on paper towels and serve. tags =  vegetarian vegan option burger main course Indian cuisine spicy healthy snack prep time =  20 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  Makes 8 burgers per serving =  Not specified

A Pilgrim's Lentil Pottage ingredients =  2 teaspoons olive oil 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1 medium onion, chopped 8 cups cold water 1 1/2 cups lentils, rinsed and drained 3 tablespoons ketchup 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper, or to taste dash freshly ground black pepper directions =  In a large soup kettle, heat oil over medium heat. Stir in garlic, carrots and onion. Cook, stirring constantly, until vegetables wilt but not brown. Add water, lentils, ketchup, cloves and salt; cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, 45 minutes or until lentils are tender. If soup gets too thick, add more water. Reheat before serving, adding pepper. Add vinegar, wine or lemon juice for extra flavor. tags =  American Legumes Soups & Stews Vegetables Healthy Hearty Dinner Comfort Food prep time =  1:00 cook time =  0:45 note =  For a variation, refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend.

ratatouille stew ingredients =  2 small new red potatoes, unpeeled, cut into 1⁄2-inch cubes 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 peeled baby eggplant, cut into 1⁄2-inch cubes 1 small, unpeeled zucchini, cut into 1⁄2-inch cubes 4 baby carrots, sliced thin 1⁄4 green pepper, chopped 1⁄2 medium onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup spaghetti sauce 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes 1⁄2 teaspoon italian seasoning 1⁄4 teaspoon salt 1⁄4 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese directions =  Put the potatoes on a microwave-safe dish, cover with wax paper, and nuke for 2 minutes. In a large skillet, warm the oil for 20 seconds. Add the eggplant, zucchini, carrots, green pepper, onion, garlic, and potatoes. Sauté for 8 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender. Stir in the spaghetti sauce, parsley, italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute more. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the veggies. tags =  food dinner vegetarian quick healthy microwave stew italian prep time =  10 min cook time =  12 min yield =  2 servings per serving =  calories 455 (from fat 225); fat 25g (saturated 4g); cholesterol 4mg; sodium 924mg; carbohydrate 51g (dietary fiber 9g); protein 10g. note =  ratatouille usually takes an hour to bake, but not this version. i’ve tailored this recipe for the microwave, so you’ll be sitting down to dinner before you can jam all the eggplant peels down the garbage disposal. tip =  don’t let the number of ingredients scare you off. this is one delicious meal! serve it with some garlic bread and you’ve reached nirvana. if you’re vegan, either omit the cheese or use grated nondairy cheese.

Baked Potato Salad ingredients =  1 kg potatoes, peeled, cubed and parboiled 1/4 cup olive oil 8 shallots, minced 1/2 tsp fresh thyme leaves 1/2 tsp fresh rosemary leaves chopped parsley for garnishing 5 cloves chopped garlic dash of black pepper juice of half a lemon 2 tsps paprika 1 tsp salt directions =  Heat the olive oil in an oven dish. Stir in potatoes. Cook for about 10 minutes or until potatoes are slightly soft. Add shallots, thyme, rosemary, black pepper, paprika, salt and garlic. Toss well to coat the potatoes evenly. Bake for another 5 minutes. Toss with lemon juice and parsley. Serve hot. tags =  salad vegetarian side dish potatoes baked herbs easy warm dish prep time =  10 minutes cook time =  15 minutes yield =  6-8 servings

Pizza ingredients =  500g./1 lb./3 cups plain flour, white or wholemeal 1 packet of easy blend dried yeast 200 ml./1 cup of warm water but keep adding until you get a good dough 1 tin chopped tomatoes (approx. 400g/14oz.) 2 tablespoons dried mixed herbs 2 tablespoons olive or sunflower oil salt and pepper to taste 1 small tin of mushrooms or/and sweetcorn (optional) sesame seeds for sprinkling on top directions =  Mix the flour with the yeast and add the water gradually. Mix well (with your hands is best) and then knead for a couple of minutes until the dough is fairly smooth. Place on a large greased baking tray and flatten into desired shape (ie. - circle). Leave in a warm place while you prepare the topping. Mix together the tomatoes, herbs, oil and seasoning in a bowl and then spread over the pizza base. If using the mushrooms/sweetcorn - coat them in a little olive oil and arrange on the top of the pizza. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake at 200 C/400 F for 15 to 20 minutes until ready. tags =  food main course vegetarian baking Italian dinner homemade easy prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  15 to 20 minutes yield =  1 large pizza variation =  Obviously you can add whatever toppings you like to the basic tomato mixture - olives, vegan 'cheeses', pineapple chunks, vegan meat substitutes etc. You can also vary the herbs used, add garlic and onion or add herbs or seeds to the base. If you want a softer base you can leave the dough to rise for half an hour before adding the toppings but we find it great without doing that.

Pizza with Fresh Vegetables ingredients =  400 g/14 oz peeled plum tomatoes, fresh or canned, weighed whole, without extra juice 2 medium broccoli spears 225 g/8 oz fresh asparagus 2 small courgettes 75 ml/5 tbsp olive oil 50 g/2 oz/3 cup shelled peas, fresh or frozen 4 spring onions, sliced 1 pizza base, 25-30 cm/10-12 in in diameter 75 g/3 oz/3 cup mozzarella cheese, cut into small dice 10 leaves fresh basil, torn into pieces 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped Salt and freshly ground black pepper directions =  Preheat the oven to 240°C/475°F/Gas 9 for at least 20 minutes before baking the pizza. Strain the tomatoes through the medium hole of a food mill, scraping in all the pulp. Peel the broccoli stems and asparagus, and blanch with the courgettes in a pan of boiling water for 4-5 minutes. Drain the vegetables and cut into bite-size pieces and slice the courgettes lengthways. Heat 30 ml/2 tbsp of the olive oil in a small saucepan. Stir in the peas and spring onions and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring often. Remove from the heat. Spread the pureed tomatoes onto the pizza dough, leaving the rim uncovered. Add the other vegetables, spreading them evenly over the tomatoes. Sprinkle with the mozzarella, basil, garlic, salt and pepper and remaining olive oil. Immediately place the pizza in the oven. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese has melted. tags =  food vegetarian pizza Italian dinner lunch fresh vegetables baked prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  25 minutes yield =  Serves 4

Mediterranean Roast Vegetables ingredients =  2 yellow peppers 2 red peppers 3 or 4 parsnips 3 or 4 carrots half a cup of sunflower oil 3 cloves of garlic a good handful of basil Seasalt directions =  Cut the peppers into chunks and scrape and do the same with the carrots and parsnips. Crush the garlic and tear the basil. Mix the garlic and basil into the oil. Thoroughly coat the vegetables in the oil mixture and place on a roasting tray. Sprinkle with seasalt and roast for about half to three quarters of an hour at 190C/380F. Serve as an accompaniment to main dishes such as nut roast, baked potatoes and casseroles. tags =  vegetarian vegan side dish Mediterranean roasted vegetables healthy gluten-free prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  45 minutes yield =  4 servings per serving =  Calories and nutritional information not provided

Sausage Patties ingredients =  8 ounces Tempeh 1/2 teaspoon Sage 1/2 teaspoon Marjoram 1/2 teaspoon Thyme 1/2 teaspoon Cumin 2 tablespoons Warm water 2 tablespoons Soy sauce 2 tablespoons Oil 2 Garlic cloves, pressed 1/2 teaspoon Red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon Oregano 1/4 teaspoon Black pepper 2 tablespoons Flour directions =  Steam tempeh for 15 minutes. Cool, grate on coarse side of grater. Mix together dry seasonings, then stir in water, oil and soy sauce. Press firmly into thin patties. Fry in a little oil until browned on both sides. For Italian Sausage: Grate the steamed tempeh. Mix together dry seasonings. Combine tempeh, dry seasonings, oil and soy sauce. Press into thin patties or crumble on top of pizza before it is baked. tags =  vegetarian sausage starter snacks plant-based gluten-free option homemade Italian seasoning prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  10 minutes yield =  2 servings per serving =  Not specified

rolled margherita pizza ingredients =  1 whole-wheat 8-inch tortilla 1⁄2 teaspoon olive oil 1⁄4 teaspoon minced garlic 3 large, thin slices ripe tomato 3 very thin slices onion 1⁄8 teaspoon italian seasoning 1⁄8 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1⁄2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar 1⁄4 fresh mozzarella ball, sliced thin 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese directions =  lay the tortilla on a microwave-safe dish, brush the oil on one side of the tortilla, and sprinkle the garlic over the oil. microwave the tortilla on high for 40 seconds. lay the tomato slices on the tortilla, and then the onion slices. sprinkle on the italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, and vinegar. lay the mozzarella slices over the top of the pizza, and then sprinkle with parmesan cheese. microwave for 40 seconds, or until the cheese has melted, and then roll up the tortilla like a burrito. tags =  lunch quick vegetarian italian snack microwave pizza easy prep time =  5 min cook time =  1 min, 20 sec yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 260 (from fat 111); fat 12g (saturated 5g); cholesterol 26mg; sodium 277mg; carbohydrate 30g (dietary fiber 3g); protein 11g. note =  this is one of the few recipes in this book where it’s not advisable to switch or substitute ingredients. the tomato slices, seasonings, and mozzarella cheese are all crucial in creating the delectable result. a traditional margherita pizza has a very thin crust. in your spare time, you can certainly make a homemade, wait-till-the-yeast-rises crust for this creation, but in an effort to save time, i use a tortilla for the base here.

Crunchy Vegetable Wraps ingredients =  4 Tbsp. nondairy cream cheese 4 10-inch flour tortillas 1 cup shredded spinach 1/4 cup alfalfa sprouts 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage 1/2 cup sliced avocado 1/4 cup chopped tomatoes 1/2 cup diced cucumbers 2 Tbsp. finely diced red onion Salt and pepper, to taste directions =  Spread 1 tablespoon of cream cheese over each tortilla. Sprinkle an even amount of the remaining ingredients on each wrap and roll up. tags =  vegetarian wrap snack healthy quick dairy-free lunch yield =  Makes 4 servings

banana berry wrap ingredients =  1 tablespoon softened low-fat cream cheese 1 whole-wheat 8-inch tortilla 1⁄2 medium banana, sliced 1⁄4 cup raspberries 2 tablespoons blueberries 1 teaspoon honey directions =  Spread the cream cheese on the tortilla. Lay the banana, raspberries, and blueberries down the center of the tortilla about two-thirds of the way down. Drizzle with honey. Fold up the bottom third of the tortilla so the filling won’t ooze out, and then bring in the sides to make a wrap. tags =  snack vegetarian fruit healthy quick dessert wrap low-fat prep time =  4 min cook time =  0 min yield =  1 serving per serving =  calories 246 (from fat 44); fat 5g (saturated 2g); cholesterol 8mg; sodium 181mg; carbohydrate 51g (dietary fiber 7g); protein 6g. tip =  vegans can enjoy this dessert by substituting nondairy cream cheese for the cream cheese and using agave syrup instead of the honey. variation =  you can use almost any nut butter and almost any sliced or cut-up fruit in this wrap, so have fun experimenting. if you don’t have honey, use pancake syrup. and if you’re into the i-need-more-sugar-than-this mode, lose the honey and drizzle chocolate syrup or caramel ice cream topping over the fruit instead.

Hummus Wrap ingredients =  3 tablespoons hummus 1 whole-wheat 8-inch tortilla 1 slice pepper jack cheese or nondairy cheese, cut in half 2 thin slices onion, separated into rings 1 roasted red pepper, cut in half lengthwise 2 thin slices green pepper 2 pepperoncini, sliced in half lengthwise 1/4 cup baby spinach leaves directions =  Spread the hummus down the center of the tortilla. Lay the cheese slices on top of the hummus. Put the onion rings, red pepper, green pepper, pepperoncini, and spinach leaves over the cheese. Stuffed Tomatoes ingredients =  8 English (small) tomatoes, or 3 beef (large) tomatoes 4 hard-boiled eggs, cooled and peeled 6 tbsp/90ml mayonnaise 1 tsp/5 ml garlic paste salt and freshly ground black pepper 1 tbsp/15ml parsley, chopped 1 tbsp/15ml white breadcrumbs for the beef (large) tomatoes directions =  Skin the tomatoes, first by cutting out the core with a sharp knife and making an incision on the other end of the tomato. Place the tomatoes in a pan of boiling water for 10 seconds, remove and plunge into a bowl of iced or very cold water to stop the tomatoes from cooking and going mushy. Slice the tops off the tomatoes, and just enough of their bases to remove the rounded ends so that the tomatoes will sit squarely on the plate. Keep the tops if using small tomatoes, but not for the large tomatoes. Remove the seeds and inside, either with a teaspoon or small, sharp knife. Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, garlic paste, salt, pepper and parsley. Fill the tomatoes, firmly pressing the filling down. With small tomatoes, replace the lids at a jaunty angle. If keeping to serve later, brush them with olive oil and black pepper to prevent from drying out. Cover with plastic film and keep. For large tomatoes, the filling must be very firm, so it can be sliced. If you make your own mayonnaise, thicken it by using more egg yolks. If you use shop-bought mayonnaise, add enough white breadcrumbs until the mixture is the consistency of mashed potatoes. Season well, to taste. Fill the tomatoes, pressing down firmly until level. Refrigerate for 1 hour, then slice with a sharp carving knife into rings. Sprinkle with chopped parsley. tags =  starter vegetarian easy quick healthy snack summer low calorie prep time =  20 minutes cook time =  10 seconds yield =  Serves 4 note =  For large tomatoes, the filling must be very firm, so it can be sliced. Spaghetti with sweet pepper and extra virgin olive oil sauce ingredients =  2 1/2 pounds fresh ripe tomatoes (2.25kg) 1 tablespoon dried oregano 1 1/2 teaspoons salt 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 large onion, thinly sliced 1 teaspoon fennel seeds 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil (60ml) 1/2 teaspoon crushed hot red pepper 3 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 celery rib, chopped 1 tablespoon unrefined cane sugar 1/2 red bell pepper, thinly sliced 1 pound spaghetti (500g) 1/2 yellow pepper, thinly sliced Handful of fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced 1 carrot, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced Freshly grated Parmesan cheese directions =  Score a shallow X with a sharp paring knife along the bottom of each tomato. Drop tomatoes in boiling water for 30 to 60 seconds. Remove with a slotted spoon and run under cold water or drop in a bowl of ice water. Peel off the skin, coarsely chop the tomatoes and set aside with their juices. In a large flameproof casserole, simmer the tomatoes uncovered with 1 teaspoon of the salt for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally and mashing down chunky pieces with the back of a spoon. Meanwhile, in another skillet, cook the onion in 2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium heat until soft but not brown, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic, celery, bell peppers, and carrot and continue to cook for another 3 or 4 minutes, or until the vegetables are very soft and the onion is golden. Add the oregano, cinnamon, fennel seeds, hot pepper, 1/2 teaspoon salt, black pepper, and sugar. Cook, stirring, for an additional 1 to 2 minutes, or until the spices are very fragrant. Add the onion and vegetables to the simmering tomato sauce. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, for another 20 minutes, or until the flavors are just right. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons oil. While the sauce is cooking, bring at least 4 quarts (4L) salted water to a vigorous boil. Add the pasta and stir immediately and often until the water returns to a boil. Cook until the pasta is al dente (slightly resistant to the bite), then drain it quickly into a colander. Shake out the water completely and transfer to plates. Immediately top with the sauce, garnish with fresh basil, and pass the cheese on the side. tags =  pasta Italian vegetarian dinner comfort food sauce main course healthy prep time =  15 minutes cook time =  70 minutes yield =  Serves 4 per serving =  Calories and nutritional information not provided
